source_quote: The mission of the Intensive English Language Program (IELP) at Rafik Hariri University
answer: The IELP's mission is to provide incoming students with high-quality English instruction to help them read, write, speak and understand English at increasingly high proficiency in a supportive environment.
Placement in IELP 085 (12 credits, up to 10 allowable major credits): TOEFL IBT 30-40, TOEFL ITP 380-439, Old SAT Writing 320-339, New SAT Writing 18, IELTS 3-3.5.
Placement in IELP 095 (12 credits, up to 10 allowable major credits): TOEFL IBT 41-52, TOEFL ITP 440-479, Old SAT Writing 340-359, New SAT Writing 19, IELTS 4.
Placement in IELP 100 (6 credits, up to 13 allowable major credits): TOEFL IBT 53-64, TOEFL ITP 480-513, Old SAT Writing 360-379, New SAT Writing 20, IELTS 4.5-5.
Placement in ENGL 101 (3 credits, regular student): TOEFL IBT 65-79, TOEFL ITP 514-549, Old SAT Writing 380-399, New SAT Writing 21, IELTS 5.5-6.
Placement directly in ENGL 210: TOEFL IBT 80+, TOEFL ITP 550+, Old SAT Writing 400+, New SAT Writing 22+, IELTS 6.5+.
